newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-HENMAN WARMS UP FOR WIMBLEDON ON EMPTY COURT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HENMAN WARMS UP FOR WIMBLEDON ON EMPTY COURT.

text.p: Britain's top player Tim Henman warmed up for Wimbledon in bizarre fashion by beating South African Grant Stafford on an empty court at the Nottingham Open on Friday.

Henman, sure to attract huge crowds from Monday at the All England club, was watched by only a handful of journalists after persistent rain forced the organisers to stage his quarter-final match on an indoor court behind closed doors.
Some 2,500 fans had come hoping to watch Henman but they were left outside.
That did not stop Henman, seeded fourth here, from beating unseeded Stafford but the Briton was made to work, needing a tie-break in the decisive set to win 3-6 6-3 7-6.
In the semifinals Henman will meet Slovakia's Karol Kucera, who beat Australian Scott Draper in three sets.
Organisers are praying for better weather but also for an all-British final between Henman and hard-hitting Greg Rusedski, who will face Australian Sandon Stolle in the other semifinal.
